messages.message: Hey! Got any new cat photos to share? I need a serotonin boost.
Haha actually yes! Just snapped this one of Luna mid-yawn 😹
STOP that’s too cute. She looks like she’s about to roar 🦁
Right?! She's basically a tiny lion with attitude.
Honestly, cats have the most chaotic energy. I love it.
They do! Luna knocked over a plant this morning and stared at me like *I* did it.
Classic cat move. My Max once pushed a glass off the table and looked proud.
Max sounds like an agent of chaos. Got a pic of him?
Always. Here he is mid-pounce. The blur adds drama 😂
He looks like he’s about to take flight 😆 10/10 form.
He trains daily by zooming at 3am. Very dedicated.
Gotta respect the hustle. Zoomies are serious business.
Agreed. Also, I caught him curled up like a cinnamon roll earlier.
Omg my heart 😭 Max is pure cozy vibes in that pic.
Right?! He's chaos and comfort all in one fluffy package.
Cats really are the best. We should set up a little kitty photo swap sometime.
Yes please! Cat content is my favorite kind of content 🐾
